name: Web Fundamentals & Browser DevTools for QA
description: Web technologies and browser architecture from a QA and test automation perspective. Covers HTML DOM inspection, crafting robust locators, browser DevTools debugging, network inspection, and understanding client/server rendering differences.

subskills.name: HTML & DOM Tree Inspection
subskills.description: Inspecting HTML elements, semantic tags, accessibility tree, DOM node hierarchy in DevTools.

subskills.name: CSS & XPath Locators for Automation
subskills.description: Crafting robust CSS selectors and XPath queries (relative, text(), contains(), axis navigation) for automation locators.

subskills.name: Browser DevTools & Console Debugging
subskills.description: Using DevTools Elements, Console, Network, and Application tabs to inspect runtime state and JavaScript exceptions.

subskills.name: Network Tab & HTTP Request Inspection
subskills.description: Analyzing HTTP requests, status codes (2xx, 4xx, 5xx), request/response headers, payloads, and cookies in DevTools Network tab.

subskills.name: Client-Side Storage & Cookies Inspection
subskills.description: Inspecting and manipulating LocalStorage, SessionStorage, Cookies, and IndexedDB during test execution.

subskills.name: CSR vs SSR & Hydration Impacts
subskills.description: Understanding CSR (Client-Side Rendering) vs SSR (Server-Side Rendering) impacts on locator readiness and hydration delays.

subskills.name: Responsive Viewports & Device Emulation
subskills.description: Testing mobile viewports, CSS media queries, and responsive breakpoint behavior via device emulation.

subskills.name: Lighthouse & Core Web Vitals Auditing
subskills.description: Using Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS, INP) to detect front-end performance regressions.

subskills.name: WebSocket & Streaming Event Inspection
subskills.description: Inspecting real-time WebSocket frames, Server-Sent Events, and streaming responses in browser networks.

github.signal: Custom XPath/CSS helper functions or locator utility classes
Browser storage manipulation or HAR network analysis scripts
Lighthouse CI audit configuration or responsive emulation fixtures

cv.signal: DevTools debugging, XPath/CSS locator creation, or Network traffic inspection
Lighthouse performance audits, responsive testing, or browser storage management

linkedin.signal: Browser DevTools, HTML/CSS, or XPath endorsed
Web Performance, Lighthouse, or Network Debugging mentioned

junior.description: Inspects DOM trees in DevTools, crafts robust XPath/CSS selectors for automation, and debugs console errors.

mid.description: Analyzes HTTP network traffic and cookies/storage in tests, handles CSR/SSR timing differences, and validates responsive viewports.

senior.description: Audits Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse metrics in CI, and inspects real-time WebSocket/SSE streaming events.
